title: 11. The Picks & Shovels of the Healthcare Industry w/Peter Mantas

reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to a new episode of the Best Anchor Stocks podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to a new episode of the Best Anchor Stocks podcast. This time, I was lucky enough to talk with Peter Mantas, one of the partners of Logos LP. We discussed the healthcare industry in general, and more specifically, the bioprocessing industry.

key_points.text: Healthcare is typically an industry deemed by many investors as out of their competent circle.
key_points.evidence_quote: Healthcare is typically an industry deemed by many investors as out of their competent circle.

key_points.text: But I'd argue that there are many different sub-industries inside healthcare, with varying degrees of risk, return, and quality characteristics.
key_points.evidence_quote: But I'd argue that there are many different sub-industries inside healthcare, with varying degrees of risk, return, and quality characteristics.

key_points.text: In today's conversation, we chose to focus on the most attractive portions of the value chain.
key_points.evidence_quote: In today's conversation, we chose to focus on the most attractive portions of the value chain.

key_points.text: We make an overview of the industry, discuss the barriers to entry, and also talk about how AI might impact these businesses.
key_points.evidence_quote: We make an overview of the industry, discuss the barriers to entry, and also talk about how AI might impact these businesses.

thesis: The speakers argue that the healthcare industry contains varying degrees of risk, return, and quality across different sub-industries, with a specific focus on the bioprocessing sector as the most attractive portion of the value chain. They characterize bioprocessing companies as high-quality 'picks and shovels' that serve as essential suppliers to large pharmaceutical firms, similar to how chemical suppliers serve the semiconductor industry.
